_comment: Pinned, reproducible TestStand corpus catalog (mirrors sources.json for the VI corpus). The .seq/config files are NOT committed (clean-room + licensing); fetch them with `dart run packages/labwright_seq/tool/fetch_seq_corpus.dart` into the gitignored seq-corpus/ at the repo root. Each source is pinned to a commit. `encoding` records the on-disk format observed during M0 reconnaissance (xml | binary-TOF1 | mixed); see packages/labwright_seq/NOTES.md.
